key_provisions_or_claims: Article 50 AI Act transparency obligations apply from 2 August 2026.
Providers must inform people of direct AI interaction and add machine-readable marks to AI-generated content.
Deployers must disclose emotion recognition, biometric categorisation, deepfakes and unreviewed AI text on public-interest matters.
Compliance can be shown via the Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-generated Content or equivalent means.
Enforced by national market surveillance authorities, the AI Office and the EDPS.
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page introducing its guidelines on Article 50 AI Act transparency obligations for providers and deployers of generative and interactive AI, deepfakes, emotion recognition and biometric categorisation. It explains scope, exemptions, compliance via the Code of Practice, and enforcement authorities. Applies from 2 August 2026.
